thread:
dan (payments-support): Heads up — Acme Corp payment hit our account this morning but the bank memo is just `ACME*INV` (truncated). Amount matches invoice total $18,240.00 but no PO or full invoice ref. Bank: First Federal, value date 2026-02-28. Need help reconciling so we don't leave the invoice open.

maria (finance): Copy. Do we have MT103 or any remittance screenshot from the customer?

dan (payments-support): Customer rep claims they put PO12345 in their payment instructions. They sent a blurry bank screenshot (link: https://files.redwood/acme/remit-blur.jpg) — you can barely read it.

kyle (recon): Quick sanity check: amount + date match is usually enough but tax/VAT rounding can break automated match. Currency? USD?

dan (payments-support): USD. No currency conversion on our side. payments-bot posted auto-match failure ID: pm-fail-20260228-8723.

payments-bot: Automated note — incoming transfer 2026-02-28 08:12 UTC. auto_match: false. reason: memo_truncated / missing_reference. match_candidates: [inv-2026-03-001 (18,240.00), inv-2026-02-198 (5,000.00)].

maria (finance): Ok. Two asks: 1) Ask Acme for MT103 / SWIFT trace (this shows ordering-to-beneficiary reference). 2) If they can't get MT103 quickly, we can apply by amount + beneficiaryacct last 4 digits + value date, but need written confirmation from customer to post-apply.

alice (acct-mgr): I'll ping Acme. Suggested template: "Please provide MT103 or a clear remittance showing payment reference and payer name. If unavailable, confirm that transfer for $18,240.00 on 2026-02-28 from account ****5678 is payment for invoice INV-2026-03-001/PO12345."

kyle (recon): FYI bank often truncates narrative to 16-24 chars depending on clearing chain — SWIFT MT103 will have /REMI/ or ordering customer field. Also check beneficiary account in ledger: last4=5678.

dan (payments-support): Customer replied: "bank refused to provide MT103, says it's internal. Attached their online payment confirmation (link)." Screenshot shows memo "PO12345 ACME" but cut off after ~12 chars.

maria (finance): If they can confirm beneficiary last4 and sign off that payment is for INV-2026-03-001, we can clear. We need a signed email from their AP team for audit. Also check VAT: invoice includes 20% VAT, was that included in payment?

dan (payments-support): Customer says total paid includes VAT. They provided a signed confirmation from their AP: https://files.redwood/acme/ap-signed.txt

kyle (recon): Steps I'll run: 1) cross-check bank trace against settlement file 2) verify beneficiary acct last4 3) create manual apply with audit note referencing signed customer confirmation 4) flag for potential refund if mismatch.

maria (finance): Sounds good. Ping me once step 1 completes. Also please attach the matched-payment journal entry to the invoice and include the signed confirmation in the ticket.

alice (acct-mgr): Sent template to Acme finance and asked for MT103 again. If they refuse, asked them to reply with exact sending account last 4 digits + confirmation text so we can apply.

dan (payments-support): Noted. Will update thread once kyle posts results. :thumbsup:

kyle (recon): Ran settlement file check — bank trace ends with ...8910, beneficiary last4 5678 matches. I'm going to create manual apply now and attach note: "Applied per customer signed confirmation — MT103 unavailable. Reconciled by amount+value date+beneficiary last4."

maria (finance): Please include payments-bot match ID and the signed confirmation link in the journal entry. Also record a follow-up to update our vendor onboarding checklist to require remittance format that survives SWIFT truncation.

dan (payments-support): Done. Manual apply completed. Journal entry: JE-20260228-5567. Attached: ap-signed.txt, remit-blur.jpg. Closing unless chargebacks show up.

maria (finance): Thanks team. Recommend ops note to billing to accept signed confirmations only when MT103 can't be produced — saves audit noise.

alice (acct-mgr): I'll loop in account owner for Acme to recommend they instruct their bank to include invoice number in the /REMI/ field or use structured remittance.

dan (payments-support): Closing thread; will reopen if bank comes back or customer disputes.
